name: alva-skill-doc-regression
description: Deterministic documentation capability checks for the Alva skill refactor. Retained cases describe behavior already present on main; pr353 cases encode the alva-ai/skills#353 chat-as-artifact standard; target cases describe this refactor's structure goals.
